_comment: Seed for the educore-papers companion page (SPEC-companionPages-102826, 'Site documents'), read by seed-companion-page.js. It holds the two EDUcore papers the DME welcome panel offers as downloads (CompanionSiteDocumentButtons.vue); it has no standardKey and isActive false, so the Standards Explorer never lists it. targetKind externalUrl points at the DME page where the papers are offered. Each originNote begins 'Version <label>;', which the button shows. The two papers carry mutual version references and are revised together (TQ, 2026-10-28): a revision of either is an upload that becomes current, naming the companion version it was checked against.
